name: p95 latency
one_line: 95th percentile end-to-end time, retrieval through verification.

formula.notation: p95 = quantile(latencies, 0.95) over 3 repeats per query

terms.meaning: retrieval, rerank, generation, citation resolution, verification
three per query; the distribution is over all of them

range.note: Wall clock seconds. Lower is better. Machine-dependent, so it is only comparable within a run set.
